withDefaults(defineProps<PrimitiveProps>(), {

});

   */

<template>
  <Primitive
    data-slot="sidebar-group-action"
    data-sidebar="group-action"
    :as="as"
    :as-child="asChild"
    :class="cn(
      'absolute top-3.5 right-3 flex aspect-square w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-md p-0 text-foreground outline-hidden ring-ring transition-transform hover:bg-secondary hover:text-secondary-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 [&>svg]:size-4 [&>svg]:shrink-0',

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Primitive, type PrimitiveProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

withDefaults(defineProps<PrimitiveProps>(), {
  as: 'div',
});

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Label text, optionally with an icon.
   */
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive
    data-slot="sidebar-group-label"
    data-sidebar="group-label"
    :as="as"
    :as-child="asChild"
    :class="cn(
      'flex h-8 shrink-0 items-center rounded-md px-2 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground outline-hidden ring-ring transition-[margin,opacity] duration-200 ease-linear focus-visible:ring-2 [&>svg]:size-4 [&>svg]:shrink-0',
      'group-data-[collapsible=icon]:pointer-events-none group-data-[collapsible=icon]:-mt-8 group-data-[collapsible=icon]:opacity-0 group-data-[collapsible=icon]:select-none',
      $attrs.class ?? '',
    )"
  >
    <slot />
  </Primitive>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

/** Current value of the input; use with `v-model`. */
const model = defineModel<string | number>();

defineEmits<{
  /** Emitted when the user changes the value. */
  'update:modelValue': [value: string | number];
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <Input
    v-model="model"
    data-slot="sidebar-input"
    data-sidebar="input"
    :class="cn('h-8 w-full bg-background shadow-none', $attrs.class ?? '')"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Main page content rendered next to the sidebar.
   */
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <main
    data-slot="sidebar-inset"
    :class="cn(
      'relative flex w-full flex-1 flex-col bg-background',
      'md:peer-data-[variant=inset]:m-2 md:peer-data-[variant=inset]:ml-0 md:peer-data-[variant=inset]:rounded-xl md:peer-data-[variant=inset]:shadow-sm md:peer-data-[variant=inset]:peer-data-[state=collapsed]:ml-2',
      $attrs.class ?? '',
    )"
  >
    <slot />
  </main>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Primitive, type PrimitiveProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

interface SidebarMenuActionProps extends PrimitiveProps {
  /**
   * Shows the action only while the menu item is hovered or focused.
   */
  showOnHover?: boolean;
}

withDefaults(defineProps<SidebarMenuActionProps>(), {
  as: 'button',
  showOnHover: false,
});

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Action icon. Add a visually hidden label for screen readers.
   */
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive
    data-slot="sidebar-menu-action"
    data-sidebar="menu-action"
    :as="as"
    :as-child="asChild"
    :class="cn(
      'absolute top-1.5 right-1 flex aspect-square w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-md p-0 text-foreground outline-hidden ring-ring transition-transform hover:bg-secondary hover:text-secondary-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 peer-hover/menu-button:text-secondary-foreground [&>svg]:size-4 [&>svg]:shrink-0',
      'after:absolute after:-inset-2 md:after:hidden',
      'peer-data-[size=sm]/menu-button:top-1',
      'peer-data-[size=default]/menu-button:top-1.5',
      'peer-data-[size=lg]/menu-button:top-2.5',
      'group-data-[collapsible=icon]:hidden',
      showOnHover && 'group-focus-within/menu-item:opacity-100 group-hover/menu-item:opacity-100 peer-data-[active=true]/menu-button:text-secondary-foreground data-[state=open]:opacity-100 md:opacity-0',
      $attrs.class ?? '',
    )"
  >
    <slot />
  </Primitive>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Component } from 'vue';
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core';
import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tooltip';
import SidebarMenuButtonChild, { type SidebarMenuButtonProps } from './SidebarMenuButtonChild.vue';
import { useSidebar } from './utils';

interface Props extends SidebarMenuButtonProps {
  /**
   * Tooltip shown when the sidebar is collapsed to icons. Accepts a string or a component.
   */
  tooltip?: string | Component;
}

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  as: 'button',
  variant: 'default',
  size: 'default',
  isActive: false,
  tooltip: undefined,
});

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Button content, usually an icon followed by a `<span>` label.
   */
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();

const { isMobile, state } = useSidebar();

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'tooltip');
</script>

<template>
  <SidebarMenuButtonChild
    v-if="!tooltip"
    v-bind="{ ...delegatedProps, ...$attrs }"
  >
    <slot />
  </SidebarMenuButtonChild>

  <Tooltip v-else>
    <TooltipTrigger as-child>
      <SidebarMenuButtonChild v-bind="{ ...delegatedProps, ...$attrs }">
        <slot />
      </SidebarMenuButtonChild>
    </TooltipTrigger>
    <TooltipContent
      side="right"
      align="center"
      :hidden="state !== 'collapsed' || isMobile"
    >
      <template v-if="typeof tooltip === 'string'">
        {{ tooltip }}
      </template>
      <component
        :is="tooltip"
        v-else
      />
    </TooltipContent>
  </Tooltip>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Primitive, type PrimitiveProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { type SidebarMenuButtonVariants, sidebarMenuButtonVariants } from '.';

export interface SidebarMenuButtonProps extends PrimitiveProps {
  /**
   * Visual style of the button.
   */
  variant?: SidebarMenuButtonVariants['variant'];
  /**
   * Height and text size of the button.
   */
  size?: SidebarMenuButtonVariants['size'];
  /**
   * Marks the button as the current page or section.
   */
  isActive?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<SidebarMenuButtonProps>(), {
  as: 'button',
  variant: 'default',
  size: 'default',
  isActive: false,
});
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive
    data-slot="sidebar-menu-button"
    data-sidebar="menu-button"
    :data-size="size"
    :data-active="props.isActive"
    :as="as"
    :as-child="asChild"
    :class="cn(sidebarMenuButtonVariants({ variant, size }), $attrs.class ?? '')"
  >
    <slot />
  </Primitive>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Primitive, type PrimitiveProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

interface SidebarMenuSubButtonProps extends PrimitiveProps {
  /**
   * Text size of the button.
   */
  size?: 'sm' | 'md';
  /**
   * Marks the button as the current page.
   */
  isActive?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<SidebarMenuSubButtonProps>(), {
  as: 'a',
  size: 'md',
  isActive: false,
});

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Button content, usually a `<span>` label.
   */
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive
    data-slot="sidebar-menu-sub-button"
    data-sidebar="menu-sub-button"
    :as="as"
    :as-child="asChild"
    :data-size="size"
    :data-active="props.isActive"
    :class="cn(
      'flex h-7 min-w-0 -translate-x-px items-center gap-2 overflow-hidden rounded-md px-2 text-foreground outline-hidden ring-ring hover:bg-secondary hover:text-secondary-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 active:bg-secondary active:text-secondary-foreground disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 aria-disabled:pointer-events-none aria-disabled:opacity-50 [&>span:last-child]:truncate [&>svg]:size-4 [&>svg]:shrink-0 [&>svg]:text-secondary-foreground',
      'data-[active=true]:bg-secondary data-[active=true]:text-secondary-foreground',
      size === 'sm' && 'text-xs',
      size === 'md' && 'text-sm',
      'group-data-[collapsible=icon]:hidden',
      $attrs.class ?? '',
    )"
  >
    <slot />
  </Primitive>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { useSidebar } from './utils';

const { toggleSidebar } = useSidebar();
</script>

<template>
  <button
    type="button"
    data-sidebar="rail"
    data-slot="sidebar-rail"
    aria-label="Toggle Sidebar"
    title="Toggle Sidebar"
    :tabindex="-1"
    :class="cn(
      'absolute inset-y-0 z-20 hidden w-4 -translate-x-1/2 transition-all ease-linear group-data-[side=left]:-right-4 group-data-[side=right]:left-0 after:absolute after:inset-y-0 after:left-1/2 after:w-0.5 hover:after:bg-border sm:flex',
      'in-data-[side=left]:cursor-w-resize in-data-[side=right]:cursor-e-resize',
      '[[data-side=left][data-state=collapsed]_&]:cursor-e-resize [[data-side=right][data-state=collapsed]_&]:cursor-w-resize',
      'group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:translate-x-0 group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:after:left-full hover:group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:bg-background',
      '[[data-side=left][data-collapsible=offcanvas]_&]:-right-2',
      '[[data-side=right][data-collapsible=offcanvas]_&]:-left-2',
      $attrs.class ?? '',
    )"
    @click="toggleSidebar"
  >
    <slot />
  </button>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Separator } from '@/components/ui/separator';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
</script>

<template>
  <Separator
    data-slot="sidebar-separator"
    data-sidebar="separator"
    :class="cn('mx-2 w-auto bg-border', $attrs.class ?? '')"
  />
</template>
